intro_long:
닉네임: 몽감독 (Director Mong)

축제로 행복한 세상을 꿈꾸며 실천하는 꿈꾸는 감독, 몽감독.

30대에는 세계공연예술축제 조직위 기획을 시작으로 서울세계무용축제(SIDance), ASSITEJ 국제총회, 창무국제예술제 등 다양한 장르의 공연예술축제 기획에 관여하며 축제감독으로서의 역량을 키워왔습니다.

40대에는 실버문화축제, 생활문화축제, 무형문화축제, 한아세안 축제 등 국내 최초로 개최되는 축제의 총감독·예술감독을 맡으며 축제총감독으로서 입지를 다졌습니다.

40대 후반부터 50대를 거치며 플랫폼형 도시문화축제 모델을 접목한 한강몽땅과 세종축제 등 도시대표축제의 총감독으로 대규모 도시축제의 기획과 연출을 이어오고 있습니다.

intro_long_en:
Nickname: Director Mong

Director Mong is a dreamer and doer who believes festivals can make the world a happier place.

In his 30s, he built his festival direction skills through the organizing committee of the '97 World Performing Arts Festival, and went on to help launch the Seoul International Dance Festival (SIDance), the ASSITEJ World Congress and World Festival of Theatre for Children and Young People, and the Changmu International Performing Arts Festival, engaging with dance, theatre, and children's performing arts across many genres.

In his 40s, he served as Festival Director and Artistic Director for Korea's first editions of the Silver Culture Festival, the Living Culture Festival, the Intangible Heritage Festival, and the ASEAN-Korea Festival, establishing himself as a leading festival director through new and original programming.

From his late 40s through his 50s, he has continued to plan and direct large-scale city festivals as Festival Director of flagship urban festivals such as Hangang Mongttang and the Sejong Festival, applying a platform-based model for city culture festivals.
